announcements.headline: Ipsen - October 2026 - Monthly information relative to the total number of voting rights and shares composing the share capital
announcements.insight: This routine monthly update on voting rights follows recent board appointments and guidance upgrades, serving as standard administrative housekeeping for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Ipsen delivers outstanding sales growth in the first nine months of 2026 and further upgrades its full-year guidance
announcements.insight: Ipsen upgrades full-year guidance following H1 results, indicating sustained momentum. This reinforces positive sentiment from recent acquisitions and clinical milestones.

announcements.headline: Ipsen appoints Mariette Finet to its Board of Directors
announcements.insight: Ipsen adds Mariette Finet to its Board. This follows recent appointments of Catherine Bradley and strategic acquisitions of Memo Therapeutics and Kartos Therapeutics.

announcements.headline: Ipsen completes acquisition of Kartos Therapeutics, strengthening late-stage Oncology pipeline
announcements.insight: Ipsen completes its acquisition of Kartos Therapeutics, adding to the pipeline established by the July Memo Therapeutics deal. This strengthens the late-stage Oncology portfolio.

announcements.headline: Ipsen delivers excellent H1 2026 results and upgrades its full-year guidance
announcements.insight: Ipsen SA delivers excellent H1 2026 results and upgrades full-year guidance. This follows recent data for IQIRVO®, acquisition of Memo Therapeutics, and positive Dysport® Phase III results.

announcements.headline: Ipsen nominates Catherine Bradley to its Board of Directors as independent Director
announcements.insight: Ipsen SA adds an independent director to its Board. This governance update follows recent clinical data and acquisition announcements.

announcements.headline: Dysport® is the first botulinum toxin to achieve positive topline Phase III results in both episodic and chronic migraine.
announcements.insight: Dysport achieves positive Phase III results for migraine, marking a significant clinical milestone. This complements earlier data on IQIRVO and the Memo Therapeutics acquisition.

announcements.headline: Ipsen to acquire Memo Therapeutics AG, adding first-in-class BK polyomavirus antibody, expanding rare disease portfolio
announcements.insight: Ipsen SA acquires Memo Therapeutics AG to add a first-in-class BK polyomavirus antibody. This expands its rare disease portfolio alongside recent IQIRVO data.

announcements.headline: New late-breaking data reinforces IQIRVO®’s impact on ALP, fatigue and pruritus in PBC
announcements.insight: New data supports IQIRVO’s clinical benefits for PBC patients. This reinforces the product's value proposition but lacks commercial scale details.
